example_sentences_in_bangla: আজকের দক্ষিণহস্তের কাজটা খুব ভালো হয়েছে।
পারিবারিক দক্ষিণহস্তের কাজে সবাই মিলে খেয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Today's eating affair turned out very well.
Everyone joined in the family meal.
history: Traditionally, Bengalis used only the right hand for eating and even held the water glass with the right hand, reflecting cultural norms around cleanliness and propriety.
note: The idiom highlights the shift from traditional right-hand usage in meals to modern practices.
